````text
# #2611: Patch: the combat and mana sections say what their newer rulings say
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The rules document is the only source of truth for the engine, yet three of its sentences now say the opposite of what the game does. Later rulings changed the behavior and were linked from other places, not from these sentences. A person or a bot reading the section alone would build the old rule. Once this is built, each sentence states the current rule and links the ruling that set it. No play changes.

## Why
- **§4.1** (`spec/04-combat.md:12`) says a unit that may attack again "is not summoning sick for it; nothing else gives a unit a second attack". But Tmack Trav attacks again after each kill (R1869002) and keeps its summoning sickness for that attack (R2521002, `keepSick`). R2521002's `cards` field names §4.1, yet §4.1 does not link it.
- **§4.4 step 10** (`04-combat.md:63`) still says "Cleave (combat only)". The §6.1 row was fixed for a Spell's Cleave (R2198003, R1563001) after the M13 review's finding A-4 (`reviews/2026-10-29-m13-review.md`), but step 10 was not.
- **§2.3** (`spec/02-core-systems.md:49`) says "1 ≤ X ≤ current mana". X may be paid from borrowed mana (R1223): `why_x_refused` reads `credit::spendable_mana` (`crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs:784-786`), and its doc comment (`:775`) still quotes the old sentence.

## Proposal
Rewrite the three sentences so they state the rule the rulings set, with links, and update the code comment. Nothing else changes.

## Where it lands
`spec/04-combat.md` (§4.1, §4.4), `spec/02-core-systems.md` (§2.3), and the doc comment in `crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] §4.1 states that an extra attack refreshes the exertion and that Tmack Trav's keeps summoning sickness, linking R1869002 and R2521002.
- [ ] §4.4 step 10 covers a Spell's Cleave, linking R2198003 and R1563001.
- [ ] §2.3 bounds X by the mana the player can spend, borrowed mana included, linking R1223.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes, and no code behavior changes.

## Size and risks
Small, 3 files, with no risk to play. It is only worth doing because the spec is the one source the bots build from.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-4` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41237643144)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Three spec sentences now state the rules their later rulings set:
- **§4.1:** an extra attack after a kill gives a fresh exertion, the Classic Golem's lifts summoning sickness and Tmack Trav's keeps it. Links R1869002, R2285002, R2521002 and R636.
- **§4.4 step 10:** covers a Spell's Cleave. Links R2198003, R1563001 and R81.
- **§2.3:** bounds X by the mana the player can spend, borrowed mana included. Links R348 and R1223.

The doc comments of `why_x_refused` and `most_x` in `crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs` say the same as §2.3. No code, test, ruling note or behavior changes, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Files to touch

| File | Kind | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `spec/04-combat.md` | change | §4.1: the last bullet (line 12, "A unit whose text lets it attack again …"). §4.4: step 10 (line 63, "10. Cleave (combat only): …") |
| `spec/02-core-systems.md` | change | §2.3: the first sentence of the "X-cost cards" bullet (line 49) |
| `crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs` | change | Doc comments only: the four `///` lines above `pub fn why_x_refused` (lines 774–777) and the two above `fn most_x` (lines 804–805) |

**Do not touch:**
- any other file in `spec/`: no new or edited ruling note, no `spec/pending/2611.md`, no `spec/11-rulings.md`, no `spec/INDEX.md`;
- `spec/06-keywords.md`, whose Cleave row is already fixed;
- `spec/10-engine-guide.md`;
- `crates/cards/` (scripts, `catalog.json`, `patches/`), `apps/web/` and anything outside these three files.

No code statement changes in `play_choices.rs`, error strings included. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

**What governs it:**
- §4.1, §4.2, §4.4 and §2.3;
- rulings R1869002, R2521002, R2285002 (which replaced R424), R636, R2198003, R1563001, R81, R63, R348, R1223 and R545.

Every one of these notes exists in `spec/rulings/`.

## Steps

1. **`spec/04-combat.md`, §4.1, line 12.** Replace the whole bullet, which today reads:

   ```
   - A unit whose text lets it attack again (C+ #73.1 Classic Golem's transformed Unit after a kill) has a fresh exertion for that turn and is not summoning sick for it; nothing else gives a unit a second attack.
   ```

   with exactly this one line:

   ```
   - A unit whose text lets it attack again after it destroys a Unit (`may_attack_again`, [[§6.3]]) has a fresh exertion for that turn, the rest of [[§4.2]]'s restrictions still applying, and each such kill frees it again: one more attack, or Windfury's two ([[R1869002]], [[R2285002]]). Classic+ #73.1 Classic Golem is not summoning sick for the rest of that turn, so its extra attack may hit the hero; Stinkyscape #94 Tmack Trav keeps its summoning sickness (`keepSick`), so on the turn it entered the field its Rush lets it attack again an enemy Unit only, never the hero ([[R2521002]]). Windfury aside ([[R636]]), nothing else gives a unit a second attack.
   ```

   This also fixes the bullet's mention of the Golem's "transformed Unit", which comes from R424. R2285002 replaced R424, and now the Golem itself attacks again. It also fixes "nothing else", which was false because of Windfury, stated two bullets above.

2. **`spec/04-combat.md`, §4.4, line 63.** Replace step 10, which today reads:

   ```
   10. Cleave (combat only): if the attacker has Cleave, deal its attack to each unit adjacent to the target as separate instances.
   ```

   with exactly this line:

   ```
   10. Cleave: if the attacker has Cleave, deal its attack to each unit adjacent to the target as separate instances. A Spell's Cleave is no attack's: the Spell's effect also lands on the permanents beside a board pick, in lanes N−1 and N+1 of the pick's own row and side ([[R2198003]]), or on the cards beside a hand pick, in hand order ([[R1563001]]); the pick stays the one declared target, and no neighbour is a target ([[R81]]).
   ```

   - Copy the `−` in "N−1" and "N+1" as written: it is U+2212, as in `spec/rulings/R2198003.md`.
   - Leave the paragraph after step 10 ("If the amount is 0 after step 3 …", ending "… ([[R63]])") as it is.

3. **`spec/02-core-systems.md`, §2.3, line 49.** In the "X-cost cards" bullet, replace only this text:

   ```
   X is chosen at play time, 1 ≤ X ≤ current mana (`MIN_CHOSEN_X`, [[R348]]), and is stored on the played instance, so a card whose X the player chooses cannot be cast for X = 0, and with no mana it cannot be played at all.
   ```

   with:

   ```
   X is chosen at play time, 1 ≤ X ≤ the mana the player can spend (`MIN_CHOSEN_X`, [[R348]]), which is their current mana plus what a credit line still lets them borrow (`spendable_mana`, [[R1223]]), and is stored on the played instance, so a card whose X the player chooses cannot be cast for X = 0, and with no mana to spend it cannot be played at all.
   ```

   Leave the rest of the bullet unchanged, from "Heroic Power costs (0); …" to its end.

4. **`crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs`, `why_x_refused`.** Replace the four doc lines above `pub fn why_x_refused(`, which start `/// §2.3, R348: why this X is not one …` and end `… `most` defaults to the player's current mana.`, with these five lines:

   ```rust
   /// §2.3, R348, R1223: why this X is not one the player may choose for this card, or `Ok` when it is —
   /// "X is chosen at play time, 1 ≤ X ≤ the mana the player can spend" (`MIN_CHOSEN_X`): their current
   /// mana plus what a credit line still lends them (`credit::spendable_mana`). `legal_x_values` offers
   /// exactly the values this passes and `refuse_x` refuses exactly the ones it names, so the picker and
   /// the reducer's refusal cannot disagree. `most` defaults to the mana the player can spend.
   ```

   - Do not change the body. Its `// R1223: an X may be chosen out of borrowed mana too.` comment and the two error strings stay.
   - Every line is under the 110-character `max_width` in `rustfmt.toml`.

5. **Same file, `most_x`.** Replace its two doc lines, `/// The most X a play of this card may choose: the player's current mana for an X-cost card, and for a` and `/// copier with an X-cost text the mana left once its own price is paid (B5 E14, R545).`, with:

   ```rust
   /// The most X a play of this card may choose: the mana the player can spend for an X-cost card (R1223),
   /// and for a copier with an X-cost text what is left of it once its own price is paid (B5 E14, R545).
   ```

   Do not change the body.

## Tests

No test is added or changed. Nothing in the change can make a test fail or pass, because no code statement changes. The tests below already prove the rules the new sentences state; run them to confirm nothing moved:

- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' r1223` runs `crates/engine/tests/rules/credit_line.rs`. Among its tests, `r1223_x_and_activate_costs_borrow` shows X paid out of borrowed mana.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' r2521002` runs `crates/engine/tests/rules/may_attack_again_sick.rs`, module `r2521002_may_attack_again_keeps_summoning_sickness`.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards r1869002` runs the `c094_tmack_trav.rs` and `c073_1_classic_golem.rs` tests.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards r2198003` runs the `c026_path_of_exile.rs` and `c027_hopeful_jelly_bean.rs` tests.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards r1563001` runs the `c018_expedition12.rs` tests.

- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine --all-targets -- -D warnings`.

## Done when

- [ ] §4.1's last bullet is the text of step 1. It states the fresh exertion and the Golem's lifted and Tmack Trav's kept summoning sickness, and links R1869002, R2285002, R2521002 and R636.
- [ ] §4.4 step 10 is the text of step 2. It covers a Spell's Cleave and links R2198003, R1563001 and R81.
- [ ] §2.3's X bound is the text of step 3. It bounds X by the mana the player can spend, borrowed mana included, and links R348 and R1223.
- [ ] Both doc comments in `play_choices.rs` are replaced as in steps 4 and 5. `git diff crates/engine` shows only `///` lines.
- [ ] `git status` shows exactly the three files above changed, and no file in `spec/pending/` or `spec/rulings/`.
- [ ] These checks pass: the five test commands above, the rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings (`spec check`), clippy and cargo tests checks. Cargo tests must leave no diff in `apps/web/src/wire`.

## Risks

- **A broken link fails `spec check`.** Type each `[[R…]]` and `[[§…]]` exactly as in the steps. Every target exists: `spec/rulings/R1869002.md`, `R2285002.md`, `R2521002.md`, `R0636.md`, `R2198003.md`, `R1563001.md`, `R0081.md`, `R0348.md`, `R1223.md`, and §4.2 and §6.3 headings. Do not add the words `Ruling:` or `(ruling)`: in §2 to §10, `spec check` makes a sentence holding either marker link a ruling before it ends.
- **R-ids cited in Rust comments.** R1223, R348 and R545 all have notes, so the new comments pass `spec check`'s citation scan.
- **Behavior, determinism, replay and the AI.** Nothing changes: only Markdown and `///` lines move. `why_x_refused` and `most_x` are functions, not `ts-rs` types, so no generated TypeScript changes.
- **`classify --claims`.** No card plays differently and no fragment is pending, so they match. Do not add a fragment under `crates/cards/patches/`.
- **Scope creep.** Do not rewrite other stale mentions of the X bound or the mana check. That includes the error string "X is above your current mana", which is code. The reviewer blocks changes the task does not need.

## Open questions

These are not needed for this build and are left out on purpose. A person may file a follow-up:
- `spec/10-engine-guide.md` §10.5 step 1 still says "cost ≤ current mana after all modifiers", which R1223 also widened.
- `spec/rulings/R0348.md` still quotes "1 ≤ X ≤ current mana".
- A test comment at `crates/cards/src/scripts/core/c024_efficiency_dividend.rs:176` says "§2.3: 0 ≤ X ≤ current mana". It is true for its scenario, which has no credit line.

**Decisions taken:**
- **§4.1 also fixes the Golem and Windfury.** The bullet also gets its Golem wording (R2285002) and its "nothing else" clause (R636) corrected. Rejected: keeping them, which would leave the same bullet stating two other rules that are no longer true.
- **`most_x`'s comment is updated too.** It repeats the same stale "current mana" bound next to `why_x_refused`. Rejected: leaving it.
- **R1869002's `cards` field stays as it is.** It does not name §4.1, but no check requires it to.
````
